title: Shift Worker (T2D Basal + Daily BP & Watch)
description: 32-day synthetic Type 2 basal-only smartwatch dataset with daily blood pressure logs, demonstrating +14 mmHg systolic BP and +32 mg/dL fasting glucose spikes after <5.5h shift-work sleep nights, and -45 mg/dL evening peak reductions from 20-min post-dinner walks.
